title: VR-Based Cognitive Stimulation Games for Delirium Prevention
official: Virtual Reality-Based Cognitive Stimulation Games for Enhancing Attention and Preventing Delirium in Older Surgical Patients With Cognitive Impairment
summary: This trial aims to evaluate the feasibility, safety, and acceptability of a virtual reality (VR)-based cognitive stimulation game to reduce postoperative delirium among older surgical patients at high risk due to pre-existing cognitive impairment.
